vad.implementation: vad_wrapper::VoiceActivityDetectorWrapper, default RNN and default periodic reset
vad.input: normalized mono f32; only a 160-sample copy is clamped to FloatS16 and scaled by 32768

endpoint.clock: successfully received 10ms audio frames; capture owner must separately enforce wall-clock and device-loss cancellation
endpoint.binding: exact recording_generation; old input/error ignored; one terminal candidate per instance

fixture_construction.source_support: strip only exactly-zero leading/trailing i16 samples in derived in-memory cases; preserve every retained sample value and original WAV bytes
fixture_construction.clean: each of the four source clips
fixture_construction.pause_2000: zh_short then en_short, and en_short then zh_short, with exactly 2000ms inserted silence between nonzero supports
fixture_construction.pause_4000: same two pairs with exactly 4000ms inserted silence; report known acoustic/semantic ambiguity, never count as successful completion of intended full turn
fixture_construction.continuous: repeat zh_short or en_short nonzero support with 100ms gaps until 21000ms after 500ms lead; no crossfade, normalization or denoise
fixture_construction.device_error: 2000ms zero input then explicit same-generation device error

predeclared_targets.clean_and_pause_2000: speech_end only after final source support; lag 2500..3500ms from final nonzero source sample boundary (not a human-annotated linguistic endpoint)
predeclared_targets.pause_4000: measurement-only risk rows; preserve early termination and any future speech after terminal; no aggregate pass claim
predeclared_targets.continuous: duration_limit at exactly 20000ms; no earlier speech_end/no_speech
predeclared_targets.device_error: device_error at 2000ms and never a second terminal
predeclared_targets.processing: report per-10ms p50/p95/p99/max and initialization separately; target p99 under 10ms on tested CPU only

limitations: Acoustic VAD cannot know whether a learner is thinking or has finished.
A 4s thinking pause exceeds the frozen 2.5s quiet rule; do not hide this failure by changing the label or threshold after running.
Adult synthetic voices and synthetic low-energy noise do not validate children, quiet speech, real rooms, device noise or speaker echo.
No microphone, ASR, playback, automatic Send, wall-clock capture shutdown or voice-loop integration is exercised.
